verdict.rationale: WooCommerce documents its own REST API, which lets WC data be created, read, updated and deleted in JSON with scoped read/write keys. It also documents webhooks that send automatic event notifications to a URL of your choice. Together these give an agent a programmatic, admin-free path to order data and events. However, the evidence never specifically shows order status transitions, fulfillment or returns via the API; fulfillment is described through the dashboard, and refunds only in a WooPayments money guide. Missing for 10: explicit order-status and fulfillment endpoints, a documented returns/refunds API, order-lifecycle webhook topics, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can take an order through its post-purchase lifecycle — status, fulfillment, returns — via documented APIs and webhooks without a human in the admin

citations.quote: WooCommerce (WC) 2.6+ is fully integrated with the WordPress REST API. This allows WC data to be created, read, updated, and deleted using requests in JSON format
Webhooks let your WooCommerce store send automatic event notifications to a URL of your choice.
Choose the level of access for this REST API key, which can be Read access, Write access or Read/Write access.
